summary: 기존 action composer, queue/cancel, 진행 제어, Stop, Retry, undo와 redo를 게임용 GameActionOverlay로 이동했다. production GameScreen은 자신이 소유한 단일 turn controller를 오버레이와 HUD에 공유한다.

architecture.presentation: GameActionOverlay receives the existing SimulationTurnController; it does not instantiate a controller
architecture.legacyCompatibility: SimulationPanel remains only as a Prompt 12 compatibility shell and delegates all presentation to GameActionOverlay
architecture.overlayClose: unmounting GameActionOverlay does not call Stop or Retry, so closing the overlay does not destroy an active controller

features: natural-language action textarea with IME-safe Enter queueing and character count
existing committed report retained until the later news/report stages

commands.command: npx.cmd eslint src/components/game/GameActionOverlay.tsx src/components/game/GameActionOverlay.test.tsx src/components/game/GameHud.tsx src/components/game/GameChrome.test.tsx src/components/game/GameScreen.tsx src/components/simulation/SimulationPanel.tsx src/lib/simulation/client/use-simulation-turn-controller.ts src/lib/simulation/client/use-simulation-turn-controller.test.tsx src/lib/simulation/client/turn-request.ts src/lib/simulation/client/turn-request.test.ts

knownLimitations: 실제 provider 요청은 기존 /api/simulation/turn 경계를 그대로 사용하며 이 단계에서 backend contract를 변경하지 않았다.
